nodes.label: UI Theme Audit
nodes.rationale: Design system: NEON LIQUID GLASS. Full dark theme with deep navy background, glass-effect panels (liquid-glass, glass-panel, glass-table, glass-modal), cyan/blue/indigo/purple neon glow accents (glow-card, glow-hover, neon-border, neon-focus), radial gradient backgrounds.

nodes.label: NEON LIQUID GLASS Design System
nodes.rationale: Full dark theme. CSS classes: liquid-glass, glass-panel, glass-table, glass-modal, glow-card, glow-hover, neon-border, neon-focus, sidebar-text-glow. CSS custom properties for glow colors (cyan, blue, indigo, purple, pink). Dark theme auto-overrides bg-white and bg-gray-50.
